limitations.note: The rewrite corrected the prefix to `011` but advanced `match` by one clock by checking the incoming bit and changed the shift-register reset value from zeros to ones.

The test checked the window after shifting in the current bit and required nine post-reset samples, so its passing result validated the rewrite's assumptions rather than checking the original timing and zero-filled startup behavior.
